node.statement: PART IV — EFFICIENT MIXED STATE TOMOGRAPHY. Theorem 1.3: Mix(A_GKKT) using n = O((rd + log(1/delta))/epsilon) copies of a rank-r mixed state rho outputs rho_hat with F(rho, rho_hat) >= 1-epsilon with probability >= 1-delta, in poly(n) time. Proof: apply purification channel (Thm 1.1), run pure state tomography (Thm 1.2) on the purification in C^{dr}, then partial-trace the estimate. Fidelity guarantee follows from Uhlmann theorem.
